main_text.p: Chalybs & Chalybeum ; etsi æris olim major usus & copia fuerit. Aff. נְחַשְׁתִּי Numellam chalybeam meam; Threnuh.1.7.? Et cum Kibbutz, נְחַשְׁתָּם Aes eorum ; 2.Regum 25.13. נְחַשְׁתּוֹ Aerugo ejus, Ezech.24.v.11. נְחַשְׁתֵּךְ Aerugo tua; Ezech.16.36. id est, Virus seu Virulenta sordes ex assidua scortatione profluentes ; ut ærugo ex ære. Duale, נְחַשְׁתַּיִם Numella, Vincula chalybea, Compedes æreæ; Jud.16.21.
נְחֻשְׁתָּן m. Nechuschtran, quasi Aereus, nomen serpentis à materia sic dicti, 2.Reg.18.4.
נְחוּשׁ m. Chalybeus, Æreus, Job.6.12. Fœmin. וּמִצְחֵךְ נְחוּשָׁה Et frons tua chalybea, Jesa.48.4. כַּנְּחֹשָׁה Quasi chalybeam; Quasi æs, Levit.26.19.
נְחֹשׁ m. Chald. Æs, Dan.2.32. Emph: נְחֻשָּׁא verf.55.

נָחַת Descendit: proprie Chaldæuith est. Futur. וַתִּנְחַת עָלַי Et descendit super me: vel transitivè juxta quosdam, Descendere fecisti, Demisisti supra me manum tuam, Psalm.38:3. Et defectivè, יֵחַת Descendet; Jer.21.13. תֵּחַת Descendit; Demittit se, Prov.17:10. Irregularitèr cum Dagesch; יֵחֲתוּ Descendant; Job.21.13. Chald. Partic. præsens, נָחַת Descendentis; Dan.4.10. Niph. Præter: נִחַתּוּ בִּי Descendere facta, Demissa, Infixa sunt in me; Psalm.38.3. Reliquæ, quæ hinc esse possent, pertinent ad נָחַת; Pih. Imperat: נַחֵת Descendere fac, Deprime, Psal.65.11. Hiph. Imper. הַנְחֵת Fac ut descendant, demittant se; Joel.3.u. Chald. Impetrat. אַחַת Descendere fac, Deduc, Deporta, Esræ 5.15. Participi מְהַחֲתִין Reposita erant, vel Repositebant; Esræ 6.1. cum ה Characteristico; ut sæpè aliàs: Futur. וַתְּחַת Et repones, Esr.6.5. Hoph.Præter: הוּנְחַת Descendere factus, Depositus est, Dan.5.26.
נַחַת m. Descensus, Job.17.16. וְנַחַת Et descensum, Jesa.30. v.30.

page.notes: Hebrew vocalisation in several forms is hard to read at this scan resolution and is copied as best seen; forms marked [?] are doubtful. "Threnuh.1.7." may be Thren.1.7. The reference "verf.55." and "Joel.3.u." are copied as printed, though the numbers are uncertain. The word "Descendit" and the Hebrew forms in the large entry are only partly legible; the big initial is a Nun-Chet-Taw letter group. The entry for Hebrew ה in "cum ה Characteristico" is copied as printed. Show-through from the reverse side and edge marks are omitted.
